title: KARI static-originator Err stops multi-RI iteration
description: try_decrypt_kari now returns Err(UnsupportedAlgorithm) when a recipient matches but the originator is static. find_and_decrypt_cek propagates this Err via ? immediately, without trying subsequent RecipientInfo entries. A multi-recipient message with a static-originator KARI block (matching the decryption key) followed by a valid ephemeral KARI or KTRI for the same key would fail with UnsupportedAlgorithm instead of succeeding via the second RecipientInfo. This is a behavioral regression vs the pre-fix code (which returned Ok(None) for static-originator KARI, allowing the loop to continue). Realistic only when one sender targets the same recipient with multiple RecipientInfo blocks of different types — unusual but valid CMS. Fix: collect first-match Err and return it only after exhausting all RecipientInfo entries, or only escalate Err when zero other RI entries remain untried.
